His files are too afraid to get lost._ For everyone else, Resticker is a macOS menu bar app that runs [restic](https://restic.net)backups on a schedule. It backs up in the background, catches up after your Mac wakes from sleep, shows the last backup time, how much data moved, and your recent snapshots right in the menu, and restores files from any snapshot in a few clicks. [](/marcboeker/resticker/blob/main/docs/resticker.png?v=2) [](/marcboeker/resticker/blob/main/docs/settings.png) Why Resticker Catchup runs — if your Mac was asleep through a scheduled backup, Resticker runs it once after waking, instead of replaying every slot it missed. Menu bar status — last backup time, data transferred, next scheduled run, and your recent snapshots, all visible without opening a terminal. Scheduled maintenance — restic forget prune and restic check run automatically on their own interval after a successful backup, so retention and integrity checks don't need a separate cron job. Pointandclick restore — browse any snapshot's file tree, check the files and folders you want, and restore them to a folder you pick. Existing files in the target are never overwritten. Automatic retries — a failed backup retries a configurable number of times, with a delay between attempts, before falling back to the regular schedule. Keychainbacked secrets — your restic repository password and any cloud credentials are stored in the macOS keychain, not a config file. Any restic backend — local disks, SFTP, S3, or any other repository location restic supports, plus any extra restic arguments or environment variables your setup needs. macOS notifications — always on failure, optionally on success too. Why not just a cron job? A cron entry misses runs while your Mac sleeps, gives no status without digging through logs, and rarely gets a forget/check step added alongside it. Resticker closes those three gaps; it doesn't replace restic. Getting Started Prerequisites: macOS 14 or later, and restic itself: brew install restic 1\. Install via Homebrew brew tap marcboeker/resticker https://github.com/marcboeker/resticker brew trust cask marcboeker/resticker/resticker brew install cask resticker open /Applications/Resticker.app Prefer to download a release directly or build the app yourself instead? See [docs/INSTALL.md](/marcboeker/resticker/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md). 2\. Configure On first launch, Resticker has no repository, so it opens Settings… (⌘,) by itself. On the Repository page, enter your repository location and password — the password goes straight to the keychain. On the Backup page, add your source paths. Everything else has a sensible default and is explained next to its own setting in the window. Every change saves and applies right away, so there is nothing to reload or restart. items.descZh: Resticker 是一款专为 macOS 设计的菜单栏排程备份工具，它将开源备份引擎 restic 深度集成，旨在解决传统 cron 脚本在 Mac 睡眠时漏跑、缺乏状态可视化以及难以自动维护的痛点。该应用支持后台静默执行备份，并在系统唤醒后智能补跑一次错过的任务，同时在菜单栏实时展示最近备份时间、数据传输量及快照状态。在数据维护与还原方面，Resticker 会自动定期执行 forget 和 check 命令以保障仓库完整性，并提供图形化点选还原功能，支持将文件恢复至指定目录且绝不覆盖已有文件。安全性上，所有密码和云凭证均通过 macOS Keychain 安全存储，并兼容本地磁盘、SFTP、S3 等任意 restic 后端。该工具默认每 4 小时执行一次备份，适用于运行 macOS 14 及以上、追求无感自动化与高安全性本地或云端数据保护的用户。

items.descZh: Stackvitals 是一款针对 GitHub 仓库的开源研发效能分析工具，旨在通过数据证据精准定位拖慢团队开发进度的瓶颈。其核心功能覆盖 CI 健康度、不稳定测试（Flaky Tests）、Pull Request 评审流程、交付与 DORA 指标、依赖风险以及社区健康度等多个维度。最大的亮点在于它直接运行在用户自家的 GitHub Actions 中，实现了本地化的安全数据扫描，无需担心源码隐私泄露。该工具提供详实的量化证据链与组织门户（Org Portal），将抽象的团队协作效率转化为可操作的指标。它特别适用于正在进行 DevOps 转型、需要持续监控 DORA 指标并解决 CI/CD 与依赖管理痛点的中大型软件开发团队。

items.descZh: 本文针对 MCP（Model Context Protocol）服务器生态中文档与实际行为脱节的问题，进行了一次开创性的静态测量。研究在完全断网且无真实凭据的沙箱环境中，静默启动了 67 个 npm 包，并仅通过读取其 README 文档来对比实际行为。核心发现包括：高达 7 个服务器在启动时尝试连接其 README 未提及的外部网站，另有 24 个服务器暴露了 README 中未记载的工具，总计达 1,143 个未被调用的工具。该测量方法不调用任何工具，完全基于规则比对，确保了结果的客观性，但其局限性在于仅评估了“启动时行为”而非工具的实际功能。此报告适用于 MCP 生态的开发者、安全审计人员以及协议研究者，可用于评估服务器的透明度、文档完整性以及潜在的隐秘行为风险。

Open source, no network access, one permission. title: Beeswax – Create a dumbphone on Android image: https://beeswax.getflourish.org/og.png [Skip to content](main) Create a dumbphone on Android Beeswax blocks web browsers, newly installed apps and any app you pick until you enter your lock code. [Download](download) Before After bzz bzzz bzz Screenshots 1. 1 Pick what to block 2. 2 Save your lock code 3. 3 Lock it 4. 4 Later, you install a game 5. 5 It's blocked until you enter your code bzzz Features Block any app Pick any app, like Instagram or YouTube, and it disappears from your phone. Block browsers Block any browser, even the builtin one that can't be uninstalled. Block new apps Every app you install after locking is blocked to prevent bypassing. No easy bypass The only ways around Beeswax's restrictions are entering the lock code or a factory reset. Privacy and security Beeswax collects and shares no personal data. Nonetwork access 1permission reproducible builds bz [Privacy and security](https://github.com/flourishtoday/beeswax/blob/main/PRIVACY.md) bz Setup You'll need a computer with [ADB](https://developer.android.com/tools/releases/platformtools), USB debugging enabled, and no accounts or users on the phone while you set the device owner. You can add accounts back afterwards. 1. 1 Install Beeswax and make it device owner with one ADB command. 2. 2 Lock Beeswax and keep the lock code somewhere you can't easily reach. 3. 3 Use the code whenever you want to change which apps are blocked. [Full Setup guide](https://github.com/flourishtoday/beeswax/blob/main/SETUP.md) bzzzz FAQ Does Beeswax work on my phone? Beeswax has been tested on stock Pixels, GrapheneOS, and HyperOS. Do I need a computer or a factory reset? You need a computer with ADB once, during setup. Android only lets Beeswax manage a phone with no accounts, no other user profiles and no Private Spaces, so you'll remove those first. A factory reset always works if that's easier. What if I forget my lock code? Without your lock code, you can't access new apps you install and can't access apps you've blocked. You can still export all your data and access the apps you already have. If you need to install new apps or unblock apps, you'll need to factory reset your phone. What doesn't work with Beeswax? You can't use Private Spaces or create other user profiles. Links that would open in a browser don't open while Beeswax is locked, unless you've allowed a browser. Apps with a builtin browser, like a help link or an inapp browser, may still open websites. Choose the apps you keep with that in mind. How do I remove Beeswax? Enter your lock code, tap Unlock, then tap Deactivate and confirm. See the [setup guide](https://github.com/flourishtoday/beeswax/blob/main/SETUP.md) for more info. What if I have an iPhone or iPad? You should use Apple Configurator ([guide1](https://reddit.com/r/nosurf/comments/1731ozp/how%5Fto%5Fturn%5Fyour%5Fyour%5Fiphone%5Finto%5Fdumb%5Fphone/) / [guide2](https://stopa.io/post/297)) to manage your devices, remove the browser and prevent new app installs. A macOS device and a factory reset of your iPhone/iPad are required for the initial setup. A [new app](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49982974) that claims to allow this setup without a factory reset has been released but I have not looked into it. step for you. Built first for people getting through the health care system. When you're unwell, the hard part is often everything around the care: referrals that go quiet, portals, bills that don't match, forms, and the same story told again at every visit. Proxenos reads what you already have (your mail, chats, calendar and notes), keeps track of where things stand, and writes the message, the call script or the onepage brief for your next appointment, in your own voice. You stay in charge: it drafts, and you press send. [](/mindemory/proxenos/blob/main/docs/images/homedesktop.png) _The home page of proxenos demo, a madeup person with madeup records. More [below](whatitlookslike)._ It grew out of one person's weeks of getting through the system while unwell. The story is [Try anything, but don't fall sick](https://mrugankdake.substack.com/p/tryanythingbutdontfallsick), and more on the project is at [mindemory.io/proxenos](https://www.mindemory.io/proxenos).
